name: unscroll-desktop
description: Unscroll for desktop: local-first screen time tracking and limits
author: Unscroll contributors

scripts.build: npm run test && rm -rf out && electron-vite build && node scripts/assert-edition.mjs
scripts.dist: npm run icons && npm run build && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run icons && npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage --publish never
scripts.dist:linux:deb: npm run icons && npm run build && electron-builder --linux deb --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run icons && npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis portable --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run icons && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --publish never
